meta.notes: The list of agencies a First Sergeant routes to, used as the spine of the toolkit: installation directories and situation cards both key off these ids. Drafted from the maintainer’s brief rather than from a published list of helping agencies, so it stays status=stub until someone checks it against official guidance and against what the installations actually field. Adding, removing, or re-wording an agency is a data edit here; no component names one. mosPages names the MilitaryINSTALLATIONS program page that carries each agency, and is what scripts/import-installations.mjs reads to build a directory. An empty list means Military OneSource does not publish that agency per installation — the crisis agencies mostly fall in that bucket, which is why the worldwide fallback matters. Adding a mapping is a data edit here; the importer names no agency itself.
